teaser.en: A red-capped brittlegill with a name that, word for word, seems to compare it to a baboon's backside.
teaser.sw: Uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia nyekundu, ambao jina lake, neno kwa neno, linaonekana kuulinganisha na tako la nyani.
teaser.dg: *Russula* yenye kofiya ya kundu, ambayo dzinare, neno kpwa neno, rinaonekana kuiringanisha na hako ra nyani.

summary.en: Hako ra nyani is a brittlegill mushroom with a shiny red to orange cap. It is one of the small number of named mushrooms that Digo collectors gather.
summary.sw: Hako ra nyani ni uyoga wa jenasi *Russula* wenye kofia inayong'aa ya rangi nyekundu hadi ya chungwa. Ni miongoni mwa aina chache za uyoga zenye majina ambazo wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huzikusanya.
summary.dg: *Hako ra nyani* ni uoga wa *Russula* wenye kofiya inayong'ala, ya kundu hadi rangi ya chungbwa. Ni kahi ya aina chache za uoga zenye madzina ambazo Adigo anaotsola uoga anazitsola.

about.en:
*Hako ra nyani* is a *Russula*, a brittlegill with a smooth, glossy cap that is red to orange-red, cream gills and a stout white stem that may be flushed pink. The flesh is firm but crumbles cleanly when broken.

It is one of three Digo-named brittlegills, with the white and red *nimakoba*.
about.sw:
*Hako ra nyani* ni *Russula*, uyoga unaovunjika kwa urahisi wenye kofia laini inayong'aa ya rangi nyekundu hadi nyekundu-machungwa, matamvua ya rangi ya krimu na shina nene jeupe ambalo linaweza kuwa na wekundu wa waridi. Nyama yake ni ngumu lakini hubomoka safi inapovunjwa.

Ni mmoja wa *Russula* watatu wenye majina ya Kidigo, pamoja na *nimakoba* mweupe na mwekundu.
about.dg:
*Hako ra nyani* ni *Russula*, uoga unaovundzika rahisi, wenye kofiya laini inayong'ala ya kundu hadi rangi ya chungbwa na kundu, miraba ya rangi ya maziya, na muhi mfupi, mkulu na mwereru ambao wakati wanjina una rangi ya pinki. Nyamaze ni ngumu, ela zichivundzwa zinavundzika sawa-sawa.

Ni mwenga wa uoga mahahu wa *Russula* wenye madzina ga Chidigo, phamwenga na *nimakoba* mwereru na *nimakoba* wa kundu.

where.en: Brittlegills grow on the ground in woodland, connected to the roots of trees.
where.sw: Uyoga wa aina hii huota ardhini msituni, ukiunganishwa na mizizi ya miti.
where.dg: Uoga wa *Russula* unamera photsi matsakani, phamwenga na mizi ya mihi.

uses.en: Pakia notes that Digo collectors only name the mushrooms they know as edible, so this one is very likely collected and eaten. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa wakusanyaji wa Kidigo huipa majina uyoga tu wanaoujua kuwa unalika, kwa hiyo huenda sana huu hukusanywa na kuliwa. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala Adigo anaotsola uoga ana madzina tu ga uoga ambao anaumanya kukala unariwa, kpwa hivyo kuna dalili nyinji kukala uoga huno nkutsolwa na kuriwa. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

names.en: Pakia records *hako ra nyani* but does not explain it. In the Mgombato dictionary *hako* is 'buttock' and *nyani* is 'baboon', so the name may read 'baboon's buttock', perhaps for the bright red cap.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *hako ra nyani* lakini haelezi maana yake. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *hako* ni 'tako' na *nyani* ni 'nyani', kwa hiyo jina hili linaweza kusomeka 'tako la nyani', pengine kwa sababu ya kofia yake nyekundu angavu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *hako ra nyani* ela kaeleza manaye. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *hako* ni 'tako' na *nyani* ni nyani, kpwa hivyo dzina rinaweza kumaanisha 'hako ra nyani', chahi kpwa sababu ya kofiya ya kundu inayong'ala.

reason.sw: uyoga wa maziwa wa jamii moja
